description: High quality stationery item for students and offices.
shortDescription: High quality stationery item for students and offices.

name: Classmate Pulse 6-Subject Spiral Notebook A4
description: Premium A4 single-subject spiral notebook with high-opacity 70 GSM elemental chlorine-free paper. Smooth micro-perforated pages with movable tab dividers to separate your coursework neatly.
shortDescription: 300 Pages A4 Spiral Bound with colour-coded subject dividers.

name: DOMS Zoom Ultimate Triangle Mechanical Pencil 0.7mm
description: Ergonomic triangular comfort grip mechanical pencil with shock-absorbing lead cushion. Includes 2B hi-polymer lead tube with integrated twist eraser at the back for smooth fatigue-free writing.
shortDescription: 0.7mm Hi-Polymer Mechanical Pencil with twist eraser & lead tube.

name: Camlin Kokuyo Scholar Geometry Box
description: Specially engineered high-accuracy self-centering compass and divider made of rust-proof virgin alloy. Features transparent calibrated scales with bevelled edges and scratch-resistant markings.
shortDescription: All-metal precision compass set with plastic scale, protractor & set squares.

name: Pentel EnerGel Retractable Liquid Gel Pen 0.5mm (Pack of 3)
description: High-performance quick-dry liquid gel ink combines the best qualities of liquid and gel. Dries fast even on left-handed writing without smears or smudges. Sleek barrel with latex-free comfort grip.
shortDescription: Ultra-fast drying EnerGel quick-dry ink. 0.5mm needle tip (Pack of 3).

name: Faber-Castell Tri-Colour Pencils Tin (Set of 24)
description: Vibrant triangular coloured pencils with SV-bonding process that prevents core breakage. Made from 100% certified reforested wood. Smooth blending pigments suitable for illustration and colouring.
shortDescription: Break-resistant triangular colour pencils in durable metal storage tin.

name: Flair Pastel Highlighter Set (Pack of 5 Soft Pastel Shades)
description: Subtle aesthetic pastel shades that do not bleed through notebook paper or cause eye strain. Chisel tip allows 1mm fine underlining and 4mm broad highlighting. Non-toxic water-based ink.
shortDescription: Chic pastel aesthetic highlighters: Mint, Lavender, Peach, Powder Blue & Coral.

name: SmartStation Minimalist Academic Habit & Daily Planner A5
description: Undated 12-month productivity planner crafted with premium 100 GSM fountain-pen friendly ivory paper. Features priority goal matrices, weekly habit trackers, exam revision schedules, and ribbon bookmark.
shortDescription: 100 GSM Ivory Paper, undated layout, habit trackers & exam study matrices.

name: Parker Vector Matte Black Fountain Pen with Chrome Trim
description: Iconic Parker Vector fountain pen featuring an ultra-durable resin barrel with matte black finish and stainless steel fine nib. Ergonomic tapered section provides steady ink flow with converter or Parker cartridges.
shortDescription: Matte black resin barrel with stainless steel fine nib & ink cartridge.

name: Multi-Compartment Metal Mesh Desk Organizer with Drawer
description: Keep your study desk immaculate with this 6-compartment electroplated steel mesh desktop caddy. Includes a smooth sliding drawer for paperclips and sticky notes, dual upright pen slots, and notebook shelf.
shortDescription: Electroplated steel mesh organizer with 6 compartments & sliding drawer.

name: Staedtler Mars Lumograph Graphite Sketching Pencils (Tin of 6)
description: Finest German drafting and sketching pencils with super-bonded lead formulation for extreme break resistance. Includes 6 distinct artist grading leads: 2H, HB, B, 2B, 4B, and 6B in tin case.
shortDescription: Professional German artist sketching pencils (2H, HB, B, 2B, 4B, 6B).

specifications.material: Certified Cedar Wood with Bonded Graphite

name: SmartStation Exam Master Clear Zipper Pouch Stationery Combo
description: Exam hall compliant transparent mesh-reinforced PVC zipper pouch pre-packed with 2 blue gel pens, 2 black ball pens, 1 mechanical pencil 0.7mm, 1 dust-free eraser, 1 steel ruler 15cm, and 1 mini sharpener.
shortDescription: Official exam hall transparent pouch + 8 essential exam tools combo.

name: Cello Butterflow Classic Ball Pen Blue (Pack of 10)
description: The beloved butter-smooth daily ball pen engineered with Lubriflow low-viscosity ink system. Textured comfortable rubber grip enables speed handwriting during exams and lengthy lectures.
shortDescription: Lubriflow ink system ballpoint pen with soft rubber grip. Pack of 10.

name: Post-it Super Sticky Notes Cube 3x3 inches (400 Sheets Pastel)
description: Vibrant pastel 3x3 inch note cube with 2x the sticking power of standard notes. Sticks reliably to notebooks, monitors, doors and textbooks without leaving glue residue.
shortDescription: 400 sheets multi-pastel self-adhesive notes cube.

name: Kangaro Heavy Duty Desk Stapler with 2000 Pins Set
description: Rugged all-metal construction desktop stapler with quick-load magazine and anti-skid rubber base. Easily binds up to 30 sheets of 75 GSM paper without jam. Comes bundled with 2000 No. 10 staples.
shortDescription: All-metal desk stapler with reload indicator + 2000 staple pins.

name: Pilot V5 Hi-Tecpoint Liquid Ink Rollerball 0.5mm (Pack of 3)
description: Classic Japanese V-System liquid ink rollerball featuring an ink controller mechanism that guarantees consistent line density to the very last drop. Multi-dimple 0.5mm tip produces crisp lines.
shortDescription: Pure liquid ink with visible ink reservoir window. 0.5mm (Pack of 3).

name: Classmate Hardcover Ruled Executive Journal A5 (192 Pages)
description: Luxurious cloth-textured hardcover diary journal with 80 GSM natural shade paper. Lay-flat 180-degree thread-bound spine, integrated ribbon bookmark, and expandable back pocket for paper souvenirs.
shortDescription: 80 GSM natural shade paper with expandable back inner pocket.

name: Maped Precision Stainless Steel Scissors 17cm (Ergonomic Grip)
description: High grade brushed stainless steel blades with 3D ergonomic soft ring handles. Precise cutting action through cardstock, fabrics, ribbons and paper without hand fatigue.
shortDescription: 17cm brushed stainless steel blades with soft finger grip rings.

name: Camlin Artist Watercolour Cakes Set of 24 with Free Brush
description: Classic water colour palette cakes crafted from finest pigments and gum arabic. Provides luminous washes, excellent lightfastness, and instant dissolution in water. Features built-in mixing palette lid.
shortDescription: 24 vibrant watercolour cake tablets in compact plastic palette box.

name: DOMS Non-Toxic Neon Eraser & Sharpener Duo Tub (Pack of 20)
description: Dust-free polymer erasers with integrated contour sharpeners in neon colours. Cleans lead graphite cleanly without tearing paper or leaving black smudges.
shortDescription: Dust-free soft erasers with anti-rust blade sharpeners in storage tub.

name: Uni-ball Eye UB-150 Waterproof Rollerball Pen (Pack of 3)
description: World-famous Uni-ball Eye featuring Super Ink: water-resistant, fade-resistant, and tamper-proof pigment ink that preserves documents for decades. Stainless steel 0.5mm micro tip.
shortDescription: Super Ink archival pigment ink. 0.5mm micro tip (Pack of 3).

name: SmartStation Artist Complete Calligraphy & Brush Lettering Kit
description: Deluxe gift box including 12 flexible tip watercolour brush pens, 1 dual-tip calligraphy marker, 1 metallic gold fineliner, 1 A5 smooth lettering practice pad (120 GSM), and step-by-step guidebook.
shortDescription: 12 brush pens + calligraphy markers + 120 GSM practice pad in gift box.

name: Reynolds 045 Fine Carbide Ballpoint Pen Blue (Pack of 20)
description: The legendary hexagonal white barrel ball pen that has powered Indian students for generations. Laser tip fine point guarantees smooth uninterrupted writing with zero blotches.
shortDescription: The classic non-slip hexagonal ball pen. Laser tip. Pack of 20.

name: Classmate Drawing Book Spiral Bound A3 Size (40 Pages 100 GSM)
description: Heavyweight 100 GSM cartridge drawing paper suited for dry and wet media including graphite, oil pastels, poster colours, and colour pencils. Heavy duty protective cardboard backboard.
shortDescription: 100 GSM premium acid-free cartridge paper. A3 landscape spiral.

name: Casio FX-991CW Scientific Calculator (ClassWiz Edition)
description: Standard approved scientific calculator for engineering, commerce and CBSE/ICSE college examinations. Features 540+ functions, natural textbook display, QR code result graphing, and twin solar/battery power.
shortDescription: 540+ functions natural textbook display scientific calculator.

specifications.material: Hard Protective Slide-on Case with High-contrast LCD

name: Luxor Fine Permanent Marker Assorted Colours (Pack of 4)
description: Quick-drying waterproof permanent ink marker that writes on almost any surface including plastic, metal, cardboard, CDs, glass, and wood. Bullet tip creates clean bold 1.0mm lines.
shortDescription: Waterproof smudge-free permanent markers: Black, Blue, Red, Green.

name: DOMS Champions Acrylic Colour Set (12 Shades x 10ml Tubes)
description: Heavy body artist acrylic paints with brilliant satin finish and high pigment concentration. Rapid drying waterproof emulsion suitable for painting on canvas, paper, wood, terracotta, and fabric.
shortDescription: 12 rich pigment acrylic colour tubes with mixing palette.

name: Classmate Octane Neon Gel Pen (Pack of 5 Assorted)
description: Super fast Japanese waterproof gel ink with ergonomic rubber contour grip. Glides effortlessly over ruled notebook pages without smearing or scratchiness.
shortDescription: 0.5mm Japanese gel ink for high speed exam writing.

name: SmartStation Back-to-College All-in-One Desk Bundle
description: Complete academic starter kit curated for college students. Includes 2 Classmate Pulse spiral notebooks, 1 pack of 5 pastel highlighters, 3 Pentel EnerGel gel pens, 1 Post-it notes cube, and 1 stainless steel metal mesh desk organizer.
shortDescription: 2 Notebooks + 5 Highlighters + 3 EnerGel Pens + Sticky Notes + Desk Caddy.

name: JK Copier A4 Paper 75 GSM (Ream of 500 Sheets)
description: India’s most trusted copier paper with ColorLok technology. Exceptional brightness and surface smoothness prevents printer jams and produces crisp black text and rich colour prints.
shortDescription: 75 GSM high brightness copier paper for laser and inkjet printers.

name: Maped Connect Dual Sharpener & Dust-Free Eraser Combo
description: Innovative interlocking 2-in-1 tool featuring a high precision twin-hole pencil sharpener on one end and a capped rotating eraser on the other. Fits neatly inside student pencil boxes.
shortDescription: Dual hole sharpener with shavings canister + protective capped eraser.
